# Save and share

**Save** stores the design so you can come back to it. **Download** and **Export forms** give you a file to share. Your application or CMS
handles publication; Designer does not publish the form directly.

:::tip Try it

<a href="#" onclick="openMinimalWindow('https://demo.formengine.io/?&formName=event-registration&view=mui'); return false;">Open Event registration in demo</a> - opens the FormEngine demo in a popup window with the form this article starts from.

:::

<img src="/assets/guide/manage-forms/header-menu-plain.png" alt="Header menu open with Save, Download, and Export forms." />

## Save, download, and export

| Action                    | What it does                                                 |
| ------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------ |
| **Save** / **Save as...** | Stores the current design when the host app provides storage |
| **Download**              | One `.json` file for the active form                         |
| **Export forms**          | A ZIP of stored forms, for backup or another environment     |

Open the header **Menu** (hamburger) for these items. Press <span class="fe-key-combo"><kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>S</kbd></span>
(Windows/Linux) or <span class="fe-key-combo"><kbd>⌘</kbd>+<kbd>S</kbd></span> (macOS) to save when focus is on the page background.

Click-by-click steps: [Save, export, and import](/manage-forms/save-export-and-import-forms).

## Publish (go live)

Your team publishes the form outside Designer. Developers might embed the exported JSON. An admin might deploy a configuration. A CMS
might point at a new version.

Finish **Preview** testing before you request publication. See [Hand off to your technical team](/help/hand-off-to-your-technical-team).

## Design vs live form

| While designing                       | For end users                       |
| ------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------- |
| You drag components and edit settings | They type answers and click buttons |
| **Preview** simulates the live form   | The app shows the published form    |
| Undo/redo apply to the layout         | Their data is handled by the app    |

## Summary

Use the header **Menu** for **Save**, **Download**, and **Export forms**. The Manage forms pages cover each item in full.
